observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a large collection of used car engines stored in a room with red-painted walls.
The engines are piled closely together, many appear to be complete with manifolds, intake systems, and other components attached.
No visible branding or model tags are readable on any engine in either photo.
The seller claims these are Toyota Venza engines with 2AR engines and gearboxes, but no such labels or markings are visible in the photos.
The engines vary in appearance, suggesting multiple makes or models, not necessarily all Toyota.
No gearboxes are visible in the photos — only engines are shown.
The environment appears to be a storage or scrap yard, not a showroom or workshop.

claims.claim: Toyota Venza complete engine and gear box 4plug 2ar
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model tags on any engine in photo 0 or photo 1. The claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

risks.risk: Engines may not be from Toyota Venza or 2AR model as claimed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine block with visible model number or casting mark, or VIN tag.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic used engines, not Toyota-specific, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Gearboxes are not visible in photos — claim of 'complete engine and gear box' may be false.
risks.proof: Photo showing a gearbox attached to an engine or a separate gearbox unit.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as engines only, not as complete engine-and-gearbox units, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Engines may be damaged, non-functional, or have hidden wear (e.g., cracked blocks, seized parts).
risks.proof: Close-up of engine block, cylinder head, and oil pan; test run video if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working or low-quality used engines, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine block showing the model number or casting mark.
Photo showing a gearbox attached to an engine or a separate gearbox unit.
Photo of the engine's condition: cylinder head, oil pan, and block for signs of damage or wear.
Video of the engine running, if possible.
response.reason: The photos show a collection of used engines, but no visible branding or model identifiers confirm the seller's claim of Toyota Venza 2AR engines with gearboxes. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately, and risks of misrepresentation or hidden damage are high.
